text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I saw Daiichi Ruby and Ikuno 
Dictus training together.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...How does it look? As for myself, I feel 
like I'm stepping forward with plenty of 
power.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. By using slightly heavier horseshoes 
than before, my center of gravity seems to 
have stabilized just a bit.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That is extremely valuable information. 
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I am pleased to have been of service. 
Should you require reference data again, 
please contact my butler.
choice_data_list: What were the two of you up to?
What were the two of you doing?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon asking, it turned out Daiichi Ruby 
had been assisting Ikuno Dictus with 
gathering data for horseshoe development.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I was born with issues in my legs. At one 
point, it was truly terrible, but...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
At that time, I was saved by a special 
horseshoe crafted for me by a certain 
farrier.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Which is why I want to be of help to 
the farriers who looked after me, and to 
the younger Umamusume coming up after me.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
We collect data on all kinds of horseshoes 
and provide it to the farriers.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Since I was born with an irregularity in 
the shape of my legs, I use somewhat 
specialized horseshoes.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Innate issues are often things that effort 
alone cannot overcome.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I know there are people out there 
suffering from such problems.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"And also that in order to break free from 
it, you need the support of others who 
will stand by you in your suffering."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Because I myself have walked down that 
very path.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Although, it is physically impossible for 
me to be at the side of every single 
person involved.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
However, by providing Ikuno-san with this 
information—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
As horseshoes crafted from that 
information, they can offer their support.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
That is what I, as one who knows 
suffering, must do.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
It is also one of the duties I must 
fulfill, on the honor of my clan's name.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm really glad I asked for your help 
after all, Ruby-san."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Eventually, there will surely be girls 
saved by the information Ms. Ruby 
provided.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Although, your assistance might go 
unnoticed by others...
choice_data_list: It's okay, I'm sure it'll reach them!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...I certainly hope so.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—Ruby, could you lend me your shoes for a 
moment?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that, Ikuno Dictus took Daiichi 
Ruby's shoes and...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I simply applied what I've learned so far. 
I only adjusted the angle of the strike a 
bit, though...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...By stepping in deeper, did it increase 
stability? What exactly does this mean?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I simply did what I could. It's the least 
I could do to thank you, Ruby-san.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
With improved stability, there should be 
less strain, allowing for an even smoother 
run.
choice_data_list: Then let's get in some serious running!
Let's go for a run alongside Ikuno now!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Running practice seems appropriate 
to break in the newly fitted horseshoes.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Understood. If that's the case, let's keep 
running for as long as my stamina holds 
out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Daiichi Ruby continued to run 
with every ounce of her strength.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"A tandem run, you say? ...Ikuno-san, 
would that be all right with you?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Watching Ruby-san run made me 
want to get out there and run too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The match race between Daiichi Ruby and 
Ikuno Dictus was a fiercely contested 
back-and-forth, making it a thoroughly 
satisfying training session.
